page.overview:
Who is Phantom Saiyans?

The are two Saiyans from the past. They are dubbed Shorty (Brocco) and Scarface (Pumpkin) by Funimation.

The Phantom Saiyans made their debut in the Dragon Ball Z franchise as rogue Saiyans in the filler episode "Pendulum Room Peril". Mr. Popo uses the Pendulum Room to send Krillin, Yamcha, Tien Shinhan, and Chiaotzu to Planet Vegeta in the past in order to fight these two Saiyans as part of their training. The Phantom Saiyans confront and easily defeat the four Z Fighters, starting with Chiaotzu and Krillin and finishing with Tien Shinhan and Yamcha.

The two Saiyans also appear in Dragon Ball Z: Kyōshū! Saiyan. They arrive on Earth with Raditz and reappear later in the game as regular enemies with five other warriors who are not Saiyans, but are modeled after preexisting characters in the series. This caste of fighter consists of a tall Saiyan named Brocco, a Serpent named Cinnamon (he has the appearance of a gray-skinned Sansho), a fighter named Cucumber (has the appearance of an orange-skinned Saibaman), another Serpent named Herb (has the appearance of a red-skinned Nicky), another one named Jasmine (has the appearance of a blue-skinned Ginger), a fighter named Kaiware (has the appearance of a blue-skinned Saibaman), and finally, a short Saiyan named Pumpkin. Pumpkin also appeared under the name Onion as a separate enemy who can transform into a Great Ape.

Scarface and Shorty appear as non-playable enemies in Dragon Ball Z: Dokkan Battle appearing in certain Quests or Events.
